map.动员后评估采集时机：看外周血 CD34+ 绝对值是否达采集门槛: Judging collection timing after mobilization: check whether the absolute peripheral blood CD34+ count reaches the collection threshold.
map.按采集物 CD34%、WBC、体积、体重估算回输剂量（×10⁶/kg）: Estimate the reinfusion dose (×10⁶/kg) from the product CD34+ percentage, WBC, volume and body weight.
map.判断能否满足单次/双次自体移植的剂量要求（≥2 / ≥5×10⁶/kg）: Judge whether the dose meets the requirement for a single or a double autologous transplant (at least 2 or at least 5 ×10⁶/kg).
map.CD34+/μL = CD34% × WBC(×10⁹/L) × 10 / 10: CD34+/μL = CD34% × WBC (×10⁹/L) × 10 / 100; total CD34+ in the product = CD34+/μL × volume (mL) × 1000; expected yield = total × collection efficiency; dose (×10⁶/kg) = yield / body weight / 10⁶. Timing: a CD34+ count of at least 10/μL is ideal, at least 5/μL suitable, at least 2/μL low, and below 2/μL means mobilization should continue.
map.例（外周血 CD34%=0.8、WBC=25×10⁹/L、处理血量=12000: Example (peripheral blood CD34% = 0.8, WBC = 25×10⁹/L, blood volume processed = 12000 mL, collection efficiency = 40%, body weight = 70 kg): CD34+/μL = 0.8 × 25 × 10/100 = 2.0/μL; total = 2.0 × 12000 × 1000 = 2.4×10⁷; yield = 2.4×10⁷ × 0.4 = 9.6×10⁶; dose = 9.6×10⁶/70/10⁶ = 0.14×10⁶/kg, which is low, so more collection cycles or stronger mobilization is needed.
map.为什么 CD34+/μL ≥10 才理想？: Why is a CD34+ count of at least 10 per μL considered ideal?
map.外周血 CD34+ 绝对值越高，单次采集越易达到移植剂量；临床常以 ≥10–20: The higher the absolute peripheral blood CD34+ count, the easier it is to reach the transplant dose in a single collection; clinics often treat 10–20/μL or more as the best collection window, while below 5/μL the yield is low and more cycles are needed.
map.剂量 ≥2×10⁶/kg 是怎么来的？: Where does the threshold of 2×10⁶/kg come from?
map.自体造血干细胞移植经验阈值：≥2×10⁶/kg 多可稳定植入，≥5×10⁶/kg: It is an empirical threshold from autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: 2×10⁶/kg or more usually engrafts reliably, and 5×10⁶/kg or more allows a double transplant or faster haematopoietic recovery; below that, further collection is needed. In practice the transplant protocol and centre standards govern.
